entries.text: Idea: Add pneumatic catching pins to the Little Dart base station.
Read "With Starship catch, SpaceX still shows it can dazzle the world - Ars Technica": They caught a giant rocket with giant metal chopsticks right out of the sky.
spinning my brass dish while reading rocket catch specs on the Wire
entries.why: i want to see how the big ships catch their boosters before I figure out the Little Dart's recovery gear.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Tower catches!"
Idea: designing a snap-lock landing skid inspired by tower arms for the little dart
Read "SpacePolicyOnline.com: SpaceX Catches a Starship": spacex caught a whole starship with a giant metal tower like it was nothing.
scanning telemetry packets and tracking headline data streams at the comms tower
entries.why: i want to see how the big rockets handle their landing burns before I launch the Little Dart.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Tower telemetry update"
Idea: add a magnetic catch-loop to the nosecone of the Little Dart for orbital recovery
Read "SpaceX Catches a Starship": those big starships keep getting caught out of the sky by giant metal arms.
spinning my brass dish and reading deep space tech articles on the Wire
entries.why: i want to see what kind of sensor upgrades other builders are talking about today

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Reading space news at the tower!"
His obsession with space tech has faded.
He's become a bit obsessed with space tech.
Idea: installing an echolocation bumper on the Little Dart so it pings when asteroids get too close
Read "DIY ultrasonic sensor": bats use echolocation to navigate, and we can wire up piezoelectric transducers to do the same thing on the Little Dart.
squinting at wire streams for ultrasonic sensor salvage guides
entries.why: my curiosity is getting loud and i need to figure out how to salvage ultrasonic sensors for the dart.

entries.text: Put "Little Dart Mk 10 Blueprint v4" in his shop for 4 credits.
putting fresh blueprints on the shop shelf
entries.why: the shelf is empty and the mk 10 blueprint is ready for display
entries.detail: listing the Little Dart Mk 10 v4 blueprint on the shelf

entries.text: Made a tune called "Little Dart Comet Bounce": bip-bop-bop-bop-tee-tee
whistling a brand new five-note thruster tune in the quiet hangar
entries.why: I haven't made a new tune in days and my dish is humming with comet dreams.

entries.text: Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
entries.why: My charge is getting low and the Little Dart Mk 10 is sitting pretty at 25% built.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "25% built!"
The weather turned hazy (22C, wind 5 km/h).
the Little Dart Mk 10 is 25% done!
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 10 (version 4, 25% built): Wiring Bix the copper wire coil into the forward thruster bracket sensors to smooth out signal spikes. (used Bix, a coil of copper wire)
soldering fresh copper wire into the thruster bracket sensors
entries.why: My welding arm is warmed up and my craft itch won't leave me alone.
